findings: GHFspace.tex:340-347: read as R1 (DEC-43); the absolute maximality is of the base model M₁ in its own dimension, for Cauchy-complete targets of the same universe; the fourth family is the central-extension form (b) (DEC-44).
GHFspace.tex:3586-3592 ([11.i]'s proof) applies Theorem A to the target N: non-circular only through the layering A₀ (embedding, barbot_A₀) → (i) → A (G3), which is how barbot_A is assembled.
Theorem A's tame embedding into B = Γ''\Ω needs Ω simply connected (π₁(B) is an extension of Γ'' by π₁(Ω)); the paper's Ω are convex, but this has to be carried.

GHFspace.tex:3586-3590, 3616-3618: for translation spacetimes [11.i] does not need Theorem A applied to the target: the lift of f∘π : 𝐌ⁿ → N to Ñ, composed with 𝒟_N, is a global isometry g, so F∘g⁻¹ is a global section of 𝒟_N whose range is clopen; translation spacetimes are absolutely maximal among all flat targets, GH or not, and every local isometry out of them is onto (absMax_of_isTranslationSpacetime, no sorry).

Family (b) (IsCHCentralExtensionOf, Loxodromic, Def 4.18 l.1212-1214) asks 'no global fixed point', not 'nonelementary': it admits elementary groups with a loxodromic element (infinite dihedral), so A's fourth disjunct is slightly broader than BARBOT-THEOREMS §1 (A's conclusion slightly weaker than R1 as drafted); faithful to Def 4.18, and the Misner disjunct covers that case up to finite index.

kb_proposals: A local isometry descends along a surjective local isometry (IsLocalIsometry.of_comp_right) and cancels an isometric embedding on the left (of_comp_left): with these, a map out of a quotient or into an open subset is checked on the cover / on the ambient space.

In a proof about a developing pair, never `set q := UniversalCover.proj M x₀`: `set` rewrites the type of ρ : Deck (proj …) →* isom d into a shadowing copy, and hypotheses about the old ρ stop matching (`ρ✝ γ = ρ γ`).
The deck group of the ported universal cover is transitive on fibres: leftMul by cb·ca⁻¹ (UniversalCover.exists_deck_apply_eq).

A local isometry out of Γ\𝐌ⁿ is onto: lift to Ñ (mathlib existsUnique_continuousMap_lifts; 𝐌ⁿ and convex Ω are SimplyConnectedSpace via Convex.contractibleSpace), compose with 𝒟_N, rigidity (developing_unique_of_preconnected with D := Subtype.val) gives g, and range F = {z | F(g⁻¹•𝒟 z) = z} is closed (Ñ T2, t2Space_universalCover) and open.

IsLocalIsometry d f and IsGXMorphism (isom d) (Minkowski d) f differ only in form: convert with `isLocalIsometry_iff_eventually.1 h |> fun h' => ⟨h'.1, h'.2⟩` (anonymous constructor on the raw IsLocalIsometry fails: its second field is an EventuallyEq of compositions).

GH in the IsQuotientOf form: IsQuotientOf.exists_homeomorph's Φ is a local isometry by IsLocalIsometry.of_comp_right along FlatQuotient.proj; GH transfers along a surjective isometric embedding (gh_of_isQuotientOf).
